dedupe_keys.name: cyclic ageing with driving profile of a lithium ion battery module

description: VITO/EnergyVille provides voltage, current, time, temperature and ampere-hour counters from driving-profile cycling tests on two 16S1P battery packs. The modules use commercial cylindrical 18650 cells with nickel-rich and silicon/graphite electrodes. An adapted real driving profile cycles the modules. The native description states that Tcell1 through Tcell16 columns have a thirty-degree-Celsius offset. Simulation uses: the EVERLASTING parent collection establishes calibration inputs for predicting electric-vehicle battery behaviour, lifetime and range. Coverage: exact measurement periods remain unstated. Access: public native metadata describes the release and stated formats. Licence: CC-BY-NC-4.0. Current file access and cost remain unknown. Caveats: The offset is preserved as a source warning; no correction is applied to data. Related cell-level ageing data have a separate DOI. Test dates, sampling intervals and module-performance conclusions were not independently checked.
